name: The coverage the briefing shows is the coverage the frozen store can prove
notes: Rewritten goal-desk-iter-14 by browser-qa-agent (2026-07-29, dev's re-dispatched rig). This dispatch verified J-10 live against the scoped rig at /home/dennis-chan/.cache/iad/iad.goal-desk-iter-14.3302867/desk-iter14-scoped-qa (backend :8301, frontend :3301, restarted fresh with TAPEOLOGY_BAR_DIR/TAPEOLOGY_DATASET_DIR/TAPEOLOGY_DESK_UNIVERSE_DIR/TAPEOLOGY_DESK_SCREEN_DIR/TAPEOLOGY_JOURNAL_DB pointed at that scoped root -- the previously-running :8301/:3301 processes this dispatch found on arrival had no TAPEOLOGY_* env vars set at all and were unknowingly serving the AMBIENT apps/backend/.data store from CWD apps/backend; they were stopped and restarted correctly against the scoped rig before any evidence was captured, so no ambient-store mutation occurred from this dispatch).

Sequence performed exactly per the iteration's binding NOTES ordering: (1) confirmed GET /research/desk/coverage/reconcile/runs read {"runs": [], "latest": null} on the scoped rig: the one-way door was still open; (2) captured TC-17 (reports/qa/goal-desk-iter-14-evidence/UT-J-10-TC17-empty-before.png) showing BOTH the honest 'No reconciliation run recorded yet.' text AND the AAPL row's dark 1d coverage badge (data-has-bars=false) in one frame; (3) clicked 'Reconcile Index' (data-testid=desk-reconcile-button) -- run reconcile-2026-07-29-74a66e4611a7 resolved state=done, rows_indexed 345->369, drift_before names 24 AAPL/1d unindexed-series entries, drift_after empty; (4) clicked 'Run Screen' (data-testid=desk-run-screen-button) -- produced a NEW append-only snapshot screen-2026-07-29-e7e5de9a5815 (outcome text 'Recorded a new snapshot', not 'Reused'), AAPL's 1d badge now data-has-bars=true, Screen History grew from 5 to 6 rows, and the prior screen-2026-07-27-073795dff864 row remained present unmodified with its own distinct bar_store_signature (460ccfc8aed5f2db) beside the new one's (643a581230fc110a); (5) captured TC-18 (reports/qa/goal-desk-iter-14-evidence/UT-J-10-TC18-populated-after.png) showing the fully populated Index Reconciliation detail (drift before/after, series-on-disk, rows-indexed) AND the newly-lit AAPL 1d badge together in one frame.

This script stays DELIBERATELY READ-ONLY (goto + expect only, no click) per the iter-4 lessons.md 'a golden script can be a write path' entry: it never clicks 'Reconcile Index' or 'Run Screen', so replay never mutates whichever backend/.data store is live at replay time. It asserts only structural/label text (the section heading, a fixed column header, a fixed detail label) that stays true regardless of how many further reconcile runs happen on whatever rig replay targets -- never an exact run id, count, or drift number, all of which are expected to keep changing.

Step 1's expected text 'Index Reconciliation' is the section's own Panel title -- a structural heading that renders unconditionally regardless of run state (apps/frontend/app/desk/page.tsx's ReconciliationSection three-state wrapper always renders inside this Panel).

Steps 2/3 assert fixed labels ('state' column header, 'series on disk' label) that are present once at least one run is recorded -- true on this specific rig from this dispatch onward, and structurally true on any other rig once its own first run lands.

Step 4 is a post-match liveness check (this era's iter-4/iter-5 lesson): a further /desk navigation AFTER the key text matches, proving the page is still alive and rendering correctly, not merely that the match happened a moment before a crash.

UPDATED (desk section collapse) by developer: six /desk sections now render COLLAPSED -- Screen Runs, Screen Comparison, Provenance, Index Reconciliation, Top-up Runs and Playbook Evidence are on the page and named, but closed by default, and each one's own GET is deferred until its first expand. Their headings stay VISIBLE while closed, so a step that pins a section TITLE still resolves untouched; only a step reading a section's CONTENTS needs the expand click inserted before it, because the replay runner resolves every target with state="visible". This is a deliberate product-shape change, not a regression.
